about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am an AI Engineer focused on Hybrid GraphRAG, Knowledge Graphs, and Computer Vision. I build end-to-end AI workflows—from structuring complex domain data into validated Knowledge Graphs (Ontotext GraphDB, Neo4j) to fine-tuning NLP Transformers and deploying vision models with TensorRT on Edge hardware.

Backed by a strong foundation in backend architecture and systems optimization (C++, Python, Node.js), I focus on engineering efficiency, low-latency execution, and clean architectural design to deliver reliable, production-ready AI applications.

experiences.description: Architected TO_TravelRAG, an end-to-end Hybrid GraphRAG system that transforms unstructured Booking.com hotel metadata and customer reviews into a validated Knowledge Graph, orchestrating dual-engine Information Retrieval (SPARQL & Vector) powered by an Ontology-driven GraphDB core.
responsibilities: Data Extraction & Schema Alignment: Ingested Booking.com raw JSON data (hotel profiles and multi-aspect reviews), executing ontology-guided LLM extraction for aspect-sentiment-evidence triples and resolving hierarchy via vector deepening (Qdrant) and BFS schema pathfinding.

Entity Resolution (ER) & Validation: Built a 2-tier ER pipeline matching geo-spatial entities against a MongoDB Geo-Index and running cosine vector similarity (threshold >= 0.88); enforced structural integrity via SHACL shape validation and SWRL reasoning prior to Ontotext GraphDB and Neo4j loading.

Query Parsing & Ontology Mapping: Developed a query understanding engine using Entity Atomization (targets, entities, metrics) and physical unit normalization (pint), applying RRF and Noisy-OR probability across multi-index Qdrant stores to accurately ground natural language to Ontology classes.

Dual-SPARQL Compilation & Chain Relaxation: Mitigated RDF relation sparsity by compiling dual SPARQL queries: a strict schema-level query (T-Box) and an instance-grounded query (A-Box) utilizing dynamic URI anchoring (VALUES) with OPTIONAL chain relaxation to guarantee zero-result prevention.

Parallel Retrieval & Response Synthesis: Orchestrated a multi-threaded retrieval pipeline querying GraphDB for deterministic facts alongside LlamaIndex vector chunks reranked via BAAI/bge-reranker-base, consolidating outputs to synthesize citation-backed, hallucination-free Markdown responses.
tags: Semantic Web (RDF, OWL, SPARQL, SHACL, SWRL)

experiences.description: Online multiple-choice traffic exam platform with session management, history tracking, and user performance analytics.
responsibilities: Full-Stack Core: Developed the Node.js (TypeScript/Awilix/Prisma) backend, MySQL database schemas, and a responsive Next.js (Shadcn UI) exam dashboard.
State and Session Architecture: Managed live exam states in MongoDB to prevent F5 data loss, implemented JWT/Redis token blacklisting, and handled temporary registration OTP via Nodemailer.

Performance and Async Processing: Orchestrated non-blocking Promise.all flows to run parallel MongoDB snapshots and MySQL statistical updates; built a bulk question importer via BullMQ background queues.
Testing and Infrastructure: Authored 200+ integration tests using Jest and containerized services via Docker/Nginx for standalone VPS deployment.

experiences.description: Researched and engineered the Multi-Source Sentiment Analysis (MSSA) deep learning framework for Vietnamese hotel reviews on Booking.com. Fused PhoBERT deep contextual text representations with objective hotel service scores and guest booking context, utilizing Supervised Contrastive Learning (SupCon) and Focal Loss to achieve benchmark state-of-the-art results (80.93% Accuracy, 0.8080 Weighted F1-Score).
responsibilities: Multi-Source Fusion Architecture: Designed an end-to-end multi-modal architecture combining deep contextual text representations from PhoBERT with tabular hotel attributes (7 dims) and guest booking context (3 dims) into a unified 304-dimensional latent embedding.

Hidden Layer Extraction & Linear Compression: Extracted and concatenated the last 4 hidden states of PhoBERT (3072 dims), applying attention-masked mean pooling and a Linear Compressor (BatchNorm + GELU + Dropout) down to 256 dims for balanced multi-source fusion.

Hybrid Loss Optimization (SupCon + Focal Loss): Integrated an independent 2-layer Projection Head (768 -> 256 -> 128) optimized with Supervised Contrastive Loss (SupConLoss) to enforce cluster tightness, paired with Focal Loss to penalize hard samples and resolve extreme class imbalance.
Multi-Sample Dropout & Regularization: Implemented 5 parallel dropout branches (p=0.3) within the classification head to stabilize gradient flow and prevent overfitting during fine-tuning.

Extensive Benchmarking & Ablation: Empirically evaluated across 18 models (PhoBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, DistilBERT, TF-IDF + XGBoost/SVM/LR/KNN, Word2Vec, Doc2Vec); surpassed all baselines with 80.93% Accuracy and 0.8080 F1-Score, confirmed through ablation and statistical significance tests.

experiences.description: Researched, developed, and deployed Edge AI computer vision solutions in manufacturing workflows, focusing on automated visual inspection and industrial camera integration.
responsibilities: Delivered assigned tasks on schedule in close collaboration with team mentor; analyzed workflows and built features aligned with business needs.
Collaborated with mentors on real-world projects, conducting research to develop and implement effective solutions.
Acquired real-world image datasets using industrial cameras (Basler, Cognex, Dino-Lite), followed by data preprocessing and precise labeling for model training.
Configured Linux environments and integrated CUDA / Deep Learning libraries for NVIDIA Jetson platforms (Orin, Nano).
Executed the training, software implementation, and real-world deployment of YOLO models on Edge devices, leveraging TensorRT to achieve high-FPS inference with industrial camera systems.

experiences.description: A high-performance system that implements parallel and multi-threading techniques to optimize the N-List frequent pattern mining algorithm.
responsibilities: Optimization: Used C++ parallel processing to enhance tree-building and extraction efficiency.
Applied parallel computing to the N-List algorithm to speed up PPC-tree construction and data mining processes.
Performance: Achieved speedups of 3.5x or more with 4 threads, especially at lower minsub values, compared to single-threaded benchmarks.

experiences.description: Assisted instructors in conducting lectures and laboratory sessions, reviewing student code, and explaining algorithms, data structures, and programming concepts.
Web platform for managing Rubik's Cube competitions, event registrations, and news, successfully serving over 100 users during live events.
responsibilities: Backend and API Development: Built RESTful APIs and core business logic using Java and Spring Boot to handle event workflows and competitor data.
Data Integration: Engineered a conversion utility to parse and standardize custom timestamps from csTimer.net into standard date formats for score consistency.
Database and Frontend: Designed MySQL schemas for competition tracking and developed the user interface using HTML and JavaScript.

projects.title: Parallel N-List Mining - Frequent Itemset
projects.description: A high-performance parallel computing program implementing multi-threading and C++ optimization techniques for the N-List frequent pattern mining algorithm, achieving 3.5x+ speedup on multi-core CPU architectures.
responsibilities: C++ Parallel Optimization: Applied multi-threading and C++ memory optimizations to enhance PPC-tree construction and parallel frequent itemset extraction.
